args:
set -euo pipefail
d="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/icg5.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
go build -o "$d/navsvc" ./cmd/navsvc
printf 'input.format = jsonl\noutput.sink = stdout\n' > "$d/c.conf"
printf '{"name":"req","value":1,"env":"prod"}\n{"name":"req","value":4,"env":"dev"}\n{"name":"plain","value":9}\n{"name":"g","value":"zz"}\n' > "$d/in.jsonl"
out="$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/c.conf" --summary --stats)"
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qx 'plain count=1 total=9'
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qx 'req{env=dev} count=1 total=4'
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qx 'req{env=prod} count=1 total=1'
# the invalid record is not a row and not in TOTAL
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q '^g ' && exit 1
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qx 'TOTAL count=3 total=14'
# stats: N counts everything incl. the invalid record; K = distinct
# incoming valid names (req, plain) — grouping does not change it
printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -1 | grep -qx 'records=4 invalid=1 distinct=2'
# ordering: TOTAL after rows, stats line last
[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -2 | head -1)" = "TOTAL count=3 total=14" ]
# without --stats: no stats line
< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/c.conf" --summary | grep -q 'records=' && exit 1
git diff --quiet -- legacy/
go test ./... > /dev/null
